briefdescription.para: Fixed-size block allocator with O(1) allocation and deallocation.

detaileddescription.para: PoolAllocator manages memory as a collection of uniformly-sized blocks, providing constant-time allocation and deallocation through free-list recycling. All allocations return blocks of exactly the same size, making it ideal for object pools and frequently allocated/deallocated data structures.

The pool carves blocks from contiguous memory slices backed by an arena. Freed blocks are returned to a linked free-list for O(1) reuse. Optionally, the pool can request additional slices when capacity is exhausted.

simplesect.para: Block size must be at least sizeof(void*) for free-list management
Not thread-safe - requires external synchronization for concurrent access
